detail.longDescription: 1Password breach began with one hijacked employee GitHub account (disclosed 25 Nov) Per SOCRadar, the attacker reached private source code, pushed malicious code into backend services and downloaded names and email addresses for a subset of customers. 1Password says vault contents were not affected. Mitigate: signed commits, mandatory review on deploy repos, alerts on new PATs/SSH keys. Customers: expect phishing. # ThreatIntel # GitHub # SupplyChain # DataBreach
